dataset.description: This description corresponds to the Data Management Plan (DMP) prepared in the context of a funding application to the Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (FCT). Its purpose is to describe how the data generated by the proposed project will be collected, processed, stored, documented, and shared, ensuring compliance with Open Science principles, good research data management practices, and FCT requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
dataset.title: FCT - Template in English

dmp.description: This Data Management Plan outlines the strategies for handling, storing, and sharing the computational data generated in the project investigating the effects of ultra-weak electric fields on the human GABA-A receptor. The purpose is to ensure data integrity, reproducibility, and accessibility, covering molecular dynamics trajectories, adaptive sampling results, Markov State Models, and docking outputs. The DMP specifies data organization, metadata standards, storage solutions, backup procedures, and plans for public dissemination in line with Open Science principles.
